title: Headway Metric1 Field Completeness Score
dataSources: SimplePractice therapy sessions (`simplepractice:session`), Headway appointments (`headway:appointment`), BetterHelp sessions (`betterhelp:session`), CBT homework logs (`cbt:homework`), and Daylio mood entries (`daylio:mood`).
app: SimplePractice session notes, Headway appointment confirmations, BetterHelp messaging sessions, CBT homework trackers, and Daylio mood exports ingested into Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=headway:metric1
| eval complete=if(isnotnull(value) AND isnotnull(duration_min),1,0)
| stats sum(complete) as complete_rows, count as total
| eval completeness_pct=round(100*complete_rows/total,1)
description: Measures how often headway metric1 (1) events include both value and duration.
value: Incomplete exports break joins and dashboards; completeness scoring catches schema drift early.
implementation: Require `value` and `duration_min` on headway metric1 (1) events and track completeness percentage.
visualization: Single-value gauge of field completeness percent.
grandmaExplanation: It estimates how often your headway metric1 (1) exports arrive with the key numbers filled in.
